facts.fact: NITA says its certified Tier 3 data centre, managed by its private partner Smart Infraco, serves all public institutions and private businesses and runs a locally hosted cloud in Ghana.

GHA.note: Document states nothing about the national ID system.

facts.fact: NITA says that when four undersea cables were cut in March 2024 it reconnected all state institutions within 24 hours over other redundant subsea cables entering Ghana from different directions.

GHA.note: NITA's ISO 27001, 22301 and 20000 certificates are certificates and place nothing.

facts.fact: NITA, described as the host of government data, provides IT services from its Tier 3 data centre, managed with its private partner Smart Infraco, to all public institutions, per its Director General in August 2024.
NITA has a certified Tier 3 data centre offering IT services to all public institutions and to private businesses, managed by its private partner Smart Infraco.
The data centre is NITA's, Ghana's national IT agency, which runs it with its partner Smart Infraco.
NITA's Director General describes the agency as the host of government data, serving all public institutions from its data centre.

GHA.note: A business continuity certificate and redundant cables are stated; no backup site in a named place is.
Document states nothing about public debate, cuts or punishment.
Certificates awarded to NITA by auditors are not a national standards body, standard or certification offered in Ghana.
